newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam fuel bunkers jump, volume disputed.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam fuel bunkers jump, volume disputed.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers gained $2 a tonne on Thursday, but dealers disagreed as to the volume of bunker enquiries in ARA.

Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at $86.50 to $88 fob, up $2 from Wednesday. The price rise came after the barge market was quiet for most of the morning with talk in the range $83/$84 ex-wharf. Prices suddenly jerked higher as one major bought 3,000 tonnes in two separate deals at $85.

Many traders said total ARA volumes had increase ahead of a three-day weekend in most European countries, but there was much disagreement as to the scale of the rise. Some larger players said the volumes topped 30,000 tonnes and explained the strength of barge prices: others said it was below 20,000 tonnes and the sudden jump in barges was the result of traders' antics.
Hamburg bunkers meanwhile were broadly steady and business was slack. Traders said buyers had mostly covered their weekend requirements earlier in the week.

Mediterranean fuel oil was also steady, although gas oil prices mostly dipped. Most ports were quiet. Much of Spain was on holiday. Egyptian prices were about $1 a tonne firmer, as supplies they could still win business from the more expensive Gulf market. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
